about: The postcommunion of the Fourth Sunday of Advent. It asks for no new gift but that coming often to the same one make the fruit grow.

seg.tr: Having received the gifts, we ask You, Lord: may salvation bear ever greater fruit in us through frequent participation in the mystery. Through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, forever and ever.

a.g: who liveth and reigneth with Thee

ex.w001: The first two words place the prayer after receiving the sacred gifts: “the gifts having been received”.
